d: Launched in Bahrain in November 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We provide better, faster, and more accessible ways to enjoy nutritious food through technology-driven kitchens. CALO operates high-performance cloud kitchens focused on consistency, speed, and quality, delivering healthy meals at scale.
We are looking for a Chef De Partie to lead CALO’s on-demand Kitchen operation.

In this role, the CDP will be fully responsible for the kitchen ALACARTE during their shift and will oversee the entire cloud kitchen operation. This includes food production, staff supervision, inventory control, quality standards, and operational efficiency.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a single-shift, high-volume, fast-paced cloud kitchen environment, similar to heavy à la carte restaurant operations, but focused on delivering healthy food and achieving excellence in execution and delivery. The Chef De Partie will act as the main point of responsibility on-site, ensuring the kitchen performs at the highest standards at all times.
q: Proven experience as a Chef De Partie (CDP)
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in hospitality within dine-in, à la carte, casual dining, or high-volume restaurant kitchens
Strong background in heavy-pace à la carte operations
Culinary degree or equivalent professional kitchen experience
Previous experience running a kitchen or leading shifts independently
Cloud kitchen or production kitchen experience is an advantage
Must be currently present in UAE
Proficient in spoken and written English
Strong leadership with the ability to run kitchen operations independently
Excellent kitchen management and organizational skills
Ability to handle high-volume production under pressure
Skilled in staff scheduling, task delegation, and performance monitoring
Strong understanding of healthy food concepts and modern kitchen practices
Cost awareness, inventory control, and waste reduction knowledge
Ability to maintain consistency, speed, and quality simultaneously
Confident leader with a strong sense of ownership
Calm, decisive, and solutions-oriented under pressure
Supportive leader who motivates teams with empathy and fairness
Customer-focused mindset, even within a delivery-first operation
r: Take full ownership of the cloud kitchen operations during the assigned shift
Run the kitchen independently and ensure smooth end-to-end operations
Lead, supervise, and manage all kitchen staff on shift
Ensure timely preparation and dispatch of orders while maintaining Calo’s quality standards
Execute menu items consistently according to approved recipes, taste, presentation, and nutritional guidelines
Plan daily production and workflow to meet operational demand
Monitor food quality, freshness, portioning, and waste control
Manage inventory, ordering, stock rotation, and storage
Enforce strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, and sanitation regulations
Train, coach, and evaluate kitchen staff performance
Communicate clearly with team members and management (Central Kitchen)
Resolve operational issues proactively and take control of challenging situations
Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient kitchen environment
Lead by example with professionalism, discipline, and accountability

d: The Lead Specialist – HR is accountable for implementing effective people strategies through a close coordination with employees, line managers and key stakeholders. S/He acts as a point of reference on all HR functional areas and maintains an effective level of business literacy on the company, its products/services and external environment.
q: Minimum 5–7 years of relevant HR experience.
Strong understanding of UAE Labour Law and employment regulations.
Good knowledge of HR policies, procedures and best practices.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management or any other related field.
r: Provide day-to-day guidance to line management on HR functional areas including recruitment, onboarding and employee relations among others
Conduct business trips to affiliates to tackle HR related matters and tasks
Assess recruitment needs with department heads and manage the full recruitment cycle and onboarding formalities accordingly
Prepare periodic HR dashboards, analyze KPIs and metrics and recommend solutions, programs and policies
Update, develop and monitor HR policies and SOP’s, procedures and related forms as well as job descriptions and organizational charts for all departments
Follow up on the proper launch and implementation of the yearly performance appraisal ensuring fairness and transparency all across
Maintain and update the HR database, records and employee files while monitoring schedules, attendance and leaves for proper action
Develop contract terms for new hires, promotions, transfers and terminations
Conduct exit interviews identifying trends and remedial actions
Ensure that probation meetings are conducted and forms are filled in due time
Work closely with the Center of Excellence to identify and fulfill specific employee and organizational needs
Manage and solve employee relations, address performance concerns and other related issues and escalate to direct manager when and as needed
Partner with other departments such as Finance, Legal and IT achieving shared organizational goals and objectives
Maintain in-depth knowledge of legal requirements, local labor laws and HR best practices reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance
Assess and improve work relationships through creating a motivating environment to increase productivity and accomplishments
Identify training needs and participate in evaluating and monitoring training programs and related ROIs
Coordinate in the planning of HR initiatives and events focused on enhancing employee engagement and company culture
Support in the implementation of myMidis modules across all departments

d: We are supporting a leading international financial services organisation in Bahrain that is looking for an experienced Project Manager to join its Technology team.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on Project Manager who enjoys leading technology transformation, managing complex projects and working with senior stakeholders across regional markets.
You will play a key role in delivering technology initiatives, driving business change and ensuring projects deliver measurable business value.
Lead end-to-end technology projects , from planning and execution through implementation and successful delivery.
Manage project scope, budgets, timelines, resources and deliverables using Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid methodologies .
Drive IT change management, SDLC, release management and project governance .
Work closely with business leaders, technology teams, vendors and regional stakeholders.
Identify and manage project risks, dependencies and compliance requirements.
Support digital transformation, process improvement and business change initiatives .
Prepare project reports, dashboards and updates for senior management.
Ensure projects meet quality, security and regulatory standards.
Minimum 7 years of experience in technology project management.
Minimum 5 years of experience in financial services , preferably within cards, payments or banking .
Strong knowledge of Agile, Waterfall and Hybrid project delivery .
PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent certification is required.
Experience in IT governance, SDLC, change management and regulatory compliance .
Familiarity with project management tools such as Jira, Celoxis, ITSM or similar platforms .
Strong stakeholder management, communication and leadership skills.
Experience managing vendors, budgets and cross-functional teams.
Exposure to AI-enabled project management tools and automation is an advantage.
